sourceRegistryExternalRefresh.policy: A refreshed observation replaces a legacy value only when the World Bank API returns a numeric observation. When a refresh is unavailable, previously stored World Bank observations are preserved.

dataQualityPolicy.missingValue: null means unknown, unavailable, not imported, or not comparable; never zero.
dataQualityPolicy.profileScope: Source-backed country data is kept separate from modelled game context and project-derived analytics.
dataQualityPolicy.derivedValues: Direct observations keep provider, source identifier, observation year, unit, and source URL. Derived numerical indicators are created only when required inputs are numeric and all required observation years match.
dataQualityPolicy.analyticalScores: Peer-relative project analytics, not official rankings, credit ratings, combat readiness ratings, or country classifications. Each result includes coverage and input-year diagnostics.
dataQualityPolicy.qualitativeClaims: Qualitative strengths, weaknesses, strategic dependencies, and diplomatic reach must be supported by sourced indicators or explicitly tagged as analyst/game-authored. They are never inferred as facts from a missing field.

calculationModels.title: Economic capacity proxy
calculationModels.note: A project-defined comparative proxy, not an official economic ranking. Input years and component coverage must remain visible.

calculationModels.title: Economic stress proxy
calculationModels.note: Higher values mean greater relative stress among countries with valid comparable-source inputs; not a credit rating.

calculationModels.title: Industrial scale proxy
calculationModels.note: Uses economy scale and industry share only; it does not measure productivity, manufacturing complexity, domestic content, or resilience.

calculationModels.title: Defence budget scale
calculationModels.note: Requires GDP and military spending share from the same year. Measures budget scale only, not military capability or readiness.

unavailableModelSlots.title: Diplomatic influence
unavailableModelSlots.note: No score is generated until comparable sourced inputs and a versioned formula are defined.

unavailableModelSlots.title: Military capability
unavailableModelSlots.note: Military expenditure is not a substitute for military capability; no capability score is fabricated.

unavailableModelSlots.title: Resource dependency
unavailableModelSlots.note: A missing resource-context record is not evidence that a country has no resources.

unavailableModelSlots.title: Industrial resilience
unavailableModelSlots.note: The industrial scale proxy must not be presented as industrial resilience.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Manufacturing value added
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: World Bank WDI manufacturing value added series or national statistical authority; retain methodology and year.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Manufacturing value added amount. Distinct from broad industry share.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Manufacturing employment share
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: ILOSTAT or national labour statistics; preserve definition and year.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Export concentration
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Calculate from country-level product/destination export shares with all input years matching; store source rows.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Captures concentration; cannot be calculated from total export value alone.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Import concentration
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Calculate from product/source-country import shares, documenting the product classification and scale.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Top commodity export share
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: UN Comtrade or national trade statistics; specify commodity classification and year.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Proxy for commodity dependence; needs commodity-level trade data.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Energy import dependency
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: International Energy Agency or UN energy balances; preserve product scope and year.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Net energy imports relative to energy use; method definition required.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Critical imports share
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: UN Comtrade plus a versioned project list of critical goods; list and classification version required.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Share of critical inputs in total imports, with explicit category definitions.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Active military personnel
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Official defence ministry/public budget or reputable defence reference; distinguish active, reserve and paramilitary.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Personnel count, not a combat readiness score.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Reserve military personnel
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Official defence ministry/public budget or reputable defence reference; record whether trained, available or nominal reserve.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Arms transfers imported
extensionMetricDefinitions.unit: SIPRI trend-indicator value (TIV; not financial value)
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database; cite the exact reporting window and TIV interpretation.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Arms-transfer volume indicator. Must not be labelled USD or market value.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Arms transfers exported
extensionMetricDefinitions.unit: SIPRI trend-indicator value (TIV; not financial value)
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database; cite the exact reporting window and TIV interpretation.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Arms-transfer volume indicator. Must not be labelled USD or market value.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Diplomatic missions abroad
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Official foreign ministry directory or maintained diplomatic-list dataset; distinguish embassy, consulate, permanent mission and honorary consulate.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Foreign diplomatic missions in country
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Host foreign ministry or diplomatic list; define what counts as a mission.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Active treaty/alliance memberships
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Official treaty texts and organization membership lists; each entry requires start/end/validity dates.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Raw count only; strategic importance varies and must not be assumed equal.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Public-debt interest to revenue
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: IMF fiscal datasets or official budget/revenue figures; same-year numerator and denominator required.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Debt-service pressure indicator. Use interest expense definition, not total debt principal repayments.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: UN voting alignment
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: UN General Assembly voting records with a documented alignment method, voting window, abstention treatment and source rows.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Model-derived diplomatic alignment; not an official country score.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Corruption Perceptions Index score
extensionMetricDefinitions.unit: score (0-100; higher means lower perceived public-sector corruption)
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Transparency International 2025 CPI results snapshot; the embedded source is a documented mirror of publisher results. Missing countries remain null.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Corruption Perceptions Index rank
extensionMetricDefinitions.unit: publisher rank (1-182; lower numeric rank is higher position)
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Transparency International 2025 CPI results snapshot; rank is a publisher-defined ordinal and should not be treated as cardinal distance.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Human Development Index
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: UNDP Human Development Report composite indices time series, HDI_2023 field. Import an offline observation snapshot with source/year provenance before exposing numeric values.
